Name: Baldur Gallows
Description: Baldur Gallows was raised a Thorite and became a member of the Public Eye Police Force and of the Church of Thor, as his older brother Jake was. His father was a cop too, in an unknown service, and died on unknown circumstances. Having his studies paid by Jake's sold, Baldur intended to go into the top of the Public Eye instead of keeping on field work. He was also married to Astra, and they were going to qualify for a child test.
